ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Responsibility: Blake has a keen awareness of his great gifts and the obligations that accompany them. Acceptance: Literally a man before his time, the senseless evil more primitive humans perpetrate against each other leaves Blake feeling isolated and alone. While he does return to Earth when needed, he spent a great deal of time in space, searching for something better than man where he can feel at home.
